# Artists & Illustrators

> A leading platform for contemporary artists, illustrators, and art enthusiasts featuring competitions, magazine content, community engagement, and curated artwork.

Artists & Illustrators is a comprehensive resource for the British art community, offering award-winning competitions like the British Art Prize, exclusive magazine content, and a vibrant artist community. The platform serves as both a digital publication and marketplace for emerging and established artists.

## Key Topics

- British Art Prize
- Artists of the Year
- Contemporary Art Competition
- Award-winning Art
- British Artists
- Art Exhibition
- Magazine
- Artist Community
- Competitions
- Subscription
- Newsletter
- Painting, Tapestry & Sculpture
- Art Events
- How-to Guides
- Shop Artwork

## Competitions & Awards

- [British Art Prize 2025 - Artists of the Year Competition](http://awards.artistsandillustrators.co.uk/): British Art Prize 2025 competition showcasing award-winning contemporary art and celebrating artists of the year

## Magazine & Community

- [Home - Artists & Illustrators](https://www.artistsandillustrators.co.uk/home/): Homepage for Artists & Illustrators magazine and community platform offering art news, inspiration, and artist resources

## Newsletter & Engagement

- [Newsletter - Artists & Illustrators](https://www.artistsandillustrators.co.uk/newsletter/): Newsletter signup for weekly art news, inspiration, exclusive offers, and community updates
